name: spinner-skins
description: Replaces Claude Code's spinner words with a live animated skin (lava, ocean, matrix, aurora, nostromo) that shows context fill, cost, elapsed time and tool activity.

appearance.title: Terminal background
appearance.description: Picks a palette that reads on your theme.

widthPercent.title: Width (% of terminal)
widthPercent.description: How much of the terminal width the animation row spans, 10 to 100.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: 1 to 30. Lower it over slow SSH links.

showInfo.title: Show info column
showInfo.description: Mode, elapsed time, context fill, cost and tool activity to the right of the animation.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Draw a still frame; only the info column updates (once a second).
